title: Mycelium idea bridges
brief: An interactive idea-bridge map connecting mycology and materials science, treating mycelium as a structural material. A d3 force-directed graph places concepts from each field as nodes in two hues, with bridge ideas as glowing connector nodes (mycelium composites, self-healing living material, acoustic panels, mushroom packaging, mycelium bricks, Fine Mycelium leather, fungal electronics, mycotecture off-planet, Fungateria, insulation biocomposites, fungal computing, mycorrhizal carbon storage). Clicking any node opens a side panel with a two-sentence explanation and one real, July-2026-verified reference. 35 curated nodes, no generated filler.
da: Bioluminescent forest: deep moss-charcoal background, spore-white jade and chanterelle-amber glowing nodes, glowing gold bridges, organic curved links, drifting spores, serif Fraunces labels, quiet legend, hover pulse.
